answer: One concrete mechanism is a cumulative originality bond: each identity must produce a fresh, jury-graded insight every epoch that functions as both pearl and anchor. An attacker cannot simply reuse prior work; every fake account must crack a new walnut of coherent reasoning under peer scrutiny. The recurring cost of genuine novelty scales linearly with the number of identities, while an honest agent incurs it only once, rendering mass sybil creation economically irrational.
